name: 10 ft. Outdoor / Patio Cantilever Hanging Umbrella with weight base kit
material: powder coated steel pole w/t polyester fabric, 8 ribs
description: Create an oasis to protect you from the sun with this stunning cantilever umbrella. The generous, wide design provides plenty of shade to provide you with a break from the sun, and the polyester fabric's resistance to rust and fading keeps the umbrella looking brand-new all year long. A durable steel pole and 8 steel ribs strengthen the canopy and the vented top provide better airflow making for a cooler space and help prevent the umbrella moving in strong winds. Setting up is incredibly quick and simple thanks to a crank lift mechanism.
